2610.11566.title: Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research with Structured Harness
2610.11566.paper_summary: Existing Open-Ended Deep Research (OEDR) systems primarily generate reports from scratch, making them inefficient for scenarios where research reports need to be continuously maintained as new information emerges. We introduce \textbf{Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research (Incremental-OEDR)}, a research setting that treats a report as an evolving research state and incrementally updates it by preserving valid knowledge, revising outdated or incomplete content, and incorporating newly available information. To support this setting, we propose \textbf{Structured Harness}, which represents reports as structured collections of outlines, sections, and supporting evidence, and provides structured retrieval, a persistent structured evidence pool, and structured generation for selective report updating and evidence reuse. We further establish a temporal evaluation framework spanning ten years, with \emph{Single-Step Task} and \emph{Long-Chain Task} to evaluate incremental updates over both individual transitions and long-term update chains. Extensive Experiments on DeepResearch Bench and DeepConsult under both the Open-source Configuration (OC) and Proprietary Configuration (PC) show that Incremental-OEDR maintains competitive report quality while substantially improving report continuity and reducing research costs. As shown in Figure~\ref{fig:profile}, it achieves up to 0.51 higher content-level ROUGE-L F1, 0.63 higher outline-level EM F1, 33\% lower token consumption, and 61\% fewer search calls than OEDR on DeepResearch Bench. For more details, please refer to our project page: https://ioedr-project.github.io/.
2610.11566.paper_summary_zh: 現有的開放式深度研究（OEDR）系統主要是從頭開始生成報告，這使得它們在需要隨著新信息出現而持續維護研究報告的場景中效率低下。我們介紹了\textbf{增量開放式深度研究（Incremental-OEDR）}，這是一種將報告視為不斷演變的研究狀態的研究設置，通過保留有效知識、修訂過時或不完整的內容以及納入新可用信息來增量更新報告。為了支持這一設置，我們提出了\textbf{結構化工具（Structured Harness）}，它將報告表示為結構化的提綱、部分和支持證據的集合，並提供結構化檢索、一個持久的結構化證據池，以及結構化生成以便於選擇性報告更新和證據重用。我們進一步建立了一個跨越十年的時間評估框架，包括\emph{單步任務（Single-Step Task）}和\emph{長鏈任務（Long-Chain Task）}，以評估個別過渡和長期更新鏈的增量更新。在開源配置（OC）和專有配置（PC）下，對DeepResearch Bench和DeepConsult的廣泛實驗顯示，增量OEDR在保持競爭性報告質量的同時，顯著提高了報告的連貫性並降低了研究成本。如圖~\ref{fig:profile}所示，與OEDR相比，它在DeepResearch Bench上實現了高達0.51的內容級ROUGE-L F1、0.63的提綱級EM F1、33\%更低的標記消耗和61\%更少的搜索調用。欲了解更多詳細信息，請參閱我們的項目頁面：https://ioedr-project.github.io/.
